How It Works
1. The Clonal Cutting

Lǜ Sēnlín’s nursery supplies pre-rooted cuttings, selected from superior mother plants known for their potent flavour and aroma profiles. This clonal propagation ensures every Patio Rosemary ‘AromiStax’ and Genovese Pesto Mint™ you grow is genetically identical to our award-winning cultivars, guaranteeing consistent potency and performance.

2. Aeroponic Intensity in the Module

Once the cuttings are placed in the AeroHerb module, HarvestSage™ initiates a specialized program for phytochemical optimization:

  • A low-pressure aeroponic tree generates a nutrient-dense fog, surrounding the bare roots for instantaneous water and nutrient uptake.
  • The NanoSunBeam™ system delivers intense blue and UV-A spectra, intentionally stressing the plants to trigger a defence response that massively increases terpene and flavonoid production.
  • The PureLight™ glazing maintains a stable canopy temperature, preventing heat stress that can cause delicate oils to volatilize and be lost. This combination of root-zone efficiency and spectral tuning forces the herbs to concentrate their flavours, creating an intensity typically impossible outside of ideal native habitats.
3. The Sustained Flavour Harvest

The AeroHerb module is managed for continuous, potent yield.

  • The **Cut-and-Come-Again Optical Mapping – multispectral camera highlights leaves safe to cut while leaving meristems intact, extending harvest to 60 + days.** system guides you to snip stems just above growth nodes, encouraging bushier regrowth.
  • A gentle **Laminar Airflow Canopy – silent cross-flow fan creates a 0.2 m s⁻¹ air sheet, dispersing humidity pockets and reducing petal disease.** ensures humid air is dispersed, preventing mould on dense foliage like Mini-Sweet Basil without drying the leaves.
  • The system provides a weekly yield of 80–120g of exceptionally aromatic herbs, with terpene density measured 15-20% higher than soil-grown equivalents.
